# agent-docs

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A public /llms.txt markdown index built from a feature registry in config, validated on boot and guarded in CI against drift. Scaffold it with the Bakery's agent-docs recipe.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: mcp.agent-docs`.

Kit: none.
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- GET /llms.txt (route agent-docs.index) serves a markdown index as text/plain; charset=UTF-8, built from config agent-docs.features (title, description, route, path).
- The registry is public and unauthenticated: list public information only.
- Keep the validator: it rejects an empty registry, invalid or duplicate paths (same-origin, absolute), titles or descriptions with newlines or brackets, and routes that don't exist or aren't public.
- Keep the check script and the Check agent docs workflow, which fail CI when /llms.txt drifts from the registry.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "What are you adding to MCP?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=mcp.agent-docs` to see its siblings.
